verification.actual_visual_review: Actually viewed full native embedded1410x2005JPEG and rendered page, plus frontcover with MIDWAY/July1992/16-40025-101 and page1-8. Two-player diagram clearly shows each joystick with directions and five separately labeled action buttons; High Punch/High Kick/Low Punch/Low Kick/Block all readable. Start is separately placed above each panel, not counted among five action buttons. Full original page kept; scan slightly clips some right-edge prose, but the control diagram is complete and readable.
